name: Test: compiled .fxc effects (C#)
author: test
summary: FxcEffect and FxcScreenEffect: a .fxc compiled by fxc /T fx_2_0, converted by MojoShader to GLSL ES and drawn as a screen effect.
description: Build with tools/tests/build-cs.sh csfxc. Effects/*.fxc come from src/*.fx (fxc /T fx_2_0). Logs csfxc SHOT <name>, csfxc <case>: ok | FAIL and csfxc END pass=N fail=M.
